I saw MVP today and she said pray for the haters… who could nevaaaaaa look this good in natural lighting 💅
Helloooooooo all my TikTok followers 🫶 are skies bluer here??

#TiktokBan what to know:
-A Peter Thiel backed rep championed legislation to give the President the power to ban “foreign adversary owned” apps
-TikTok sued claiming Citizens United gives them 1A rights 
-A DC court found it DOES NOT 
-Ban takes effect Jan 19 UNLESS
-Biden grants a 90 day extension
2025 - no time for smugness, or faux niceties just like - talk normal. We are tired.

Let’s talk midterms!!!! Democratic House Minority Leader Hakeem Jeffries congratulated Virginia on a new referendum that passed on Tuesday night. This has allotted Democrats the opportunity for more House seats! Brian Derrick, co-founder of Oath, gives us the lowdown on the strategy ahead of the midterms and tells us whether or not Democrats have a chance for taking the house! The next big item is redistricting in Florida! What will this map look like? And will Republicans in power rig the redis

That’s very odd 👀 “could get in trouble” for reporting what they see on campus??? Dystopian. Alternatively, there will be media at the “All Are Neighbors” event today because the LGBTQ speakers are proud of what they have to say 💅#baylor
GO Bears!! #baylorbears we have a reporter at the event and will have more later today
I see you @About Face: Vets Against War 🫡 #news #nowar

DEMAND SENATE DEMOCRATS to extend what little but vital protections there are now on cryptocurrency. Any bill that seeks to diminish BSA/AML or doesn’t strongly enforce regulation is BAD for working class people like you and I - even if you don’t hold any crypto, without it being regulated it can affect the value of your AMERICAN DOLLAR. We can’t ignore it.
Canada has been GREAT - got a perfect haircut at Trufitt & Hill by my guy Alan and will be hitting up Understory Cafe tomorrow!
